usedFor: Greenhouse holds jobs, candidates and offers, and Asana receives the follow-up work through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “Candidate Hired” in Greenhouse, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A hire becomes a task with an assignee, dates, tags and a description, so the next steps have an owner.

watchOut: “Updated Application” polls and fires on every update, so one application can create several Asana tasks.
